stability: Vector NAMES are stable once published: features 03/04/06/07/08 reference them by name, so renaming or removing one breaks a downstream test. Adding vectors is safe.

vectors.name: positional-params-subtract
vectors.description: a request with positional parameters; the response carries the same id, of the same JSON type

vectors.name: positional-params-subtract-reversed
vectors.description: positional parameter order is significant to the method, and the envelope layer preserves it verbatim

vectors.name: named-params-subtract
vectors.description: params may be an object as well as an array (§4.2); both are structured forms

vectors.name: named-params-subtract-reordered
vectors.description: member order inside an object-shaped params does not change decoding

vectors.name: notification-update
vectors.description: a notification carries no id and produces no response document at all (§4.1)

vectors.name: notification-foobar
vectors.description: a notification with no params at all is still a notification, and still answers nothing

vectors.name: method-not-found
vectors.description: an unresolvable method is -32601; the id is echoed as the string it arrived as, not coerced to a number

vectors.name: invalid-json
vectors.description: input that is not well-formed JSON is -32700 with a null id: no id can be trusted from a document that did not parse

vectors.name: invalid-request-object
vectors.description: well-formed JSON that is not a valid Request object is -32600, not -32700

vectors.name: batch-invalid-json
vectors.description: a break in the ARRAY's own structure leaves no element boundaries to report against, so the answer is a single -32700 object rather than an array

vectors.name: batch-empty-array
vectors.description: an empty array is a single -32600 OBJECT, not an empty array of errors and not a batch (§6)

vectors.name: batch-invalid-single
vectors.description: a one-element batch stays a batch: its single error renders as an ARRAY of one, unlike the empty-array case

vectors.name: batch-invalid-three
vectors.description: every non-object element is refused individually; three bad elements give three errors, not one
vectors.response: [{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "error": {"code": -32600, "message": "Invalid Request"}, "id": null}, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "error": {"code": -32600, "message": "Invalid Request"}, "id": null}, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "error": {"code": -32600, "message": "Invalid Request"}, "id": null}]

vectors.name: batch-mixed
vectors.description: requests, a notification and an invalid element in one array: five responses for six elements, correlated by id alone and never by position

vectors.name: batch-all-notifications
vectors.description: a batch of notifications only produces no response document at all - distinct from an empty array
